card.name: "Throughout" and "admirable" in old prose
card.fires_on: The word "throughout" after a noun in old-style or scholarly prose, such as "forms of life throughout the world". Also fires on "admirable" before a noun such as observers or memoirs.

modes.label: throughout
modes.description: "Throughout" follows a noun and gives the place or span of time covered, in historical or scientific writing.
